customManagers.description: The container engine every install pins and catena-admin's catena-engine-upgrade moves hosts to. moby/moby tags engine releases docker-vX.Y.Z.
The containerd.io the pinned engine runs on, from Docker's apt repository.

packageRules.description: The engine pins move every host that converges, so they wait 14 days after a release and are reviewed by hand; a major also needs a bench run first.
containerd minors reach Docker's apt repository after upstream releases them, and follow docker-ce's own dependency; only patches are proposed.
